name: TINE® Ski Queen Creamy Caramel Cheese
description: Want to take your your cheese board to a new altitude? Break out of the bunny slopes and give TINE® Ski Queen® a try! First developed in the mid-1800s to utilize a byproduct of cheese-making, whey is slowly boiled until the milk sugars caramelize to create this Norwegian Sweet Brown Cheese (a.k.a. brunost). This process lends Ski Queen® its distinctly sweet flavor and characteristic golden-brown hue, while its cow and goat milk base creates a creamy mouthfeel and subtle tang on the palate. In addition to adding caramel-y charisma to a cheese or charcuterie board, it’s a boon to bagels, awesome on an Apple Crumble Pie, and wonderful when grated and folded into waffle batter made with Buttermilk Pancake & Baking Mix. Thanks to our process of traveling the world in search of unique and exceptional products, we’ve partnered with a Norwegian dairy cooperative (with 140-plus years of cheesemaking expertise, no less!) to offer an incredible value on TINE® Ski Queen® Norwegian Sweet Brown Chee

description: Is there a perfect gift? Allow us to suggest: a ballotin box—a fancy parcel, tied with a ribbon, that opens to reveal artistic truffles and pralinés inside. Convinced yet? Well, returning this year, Trader Joe’s is offering a Belgian Truffle Ballotin Box!  in festive red or blue paper and festooned with a festive, shimmery, red or silver bow, our Belgian Truffle Ballotin Box comes ready-to-gift and it includes eight curated, bite-sized chocolates with unique shapes and fillings like dark chocolate with hazelnut, white chocolate with hazelnut praliné, escargot-shaped shell with hazelnut cream and pieces of crunchy waffle, caramel-filled truffle, maple leaf with hazelnut, cappuccino chocolate with nougat, cocoa bean-shaped pod with extra dark chocolate ganache, and white chocolate with hazelnut gianduja and puffed rice. Did we mention that this item is also offered at an incredible price (similar boxes sell for over $15 each)? Gift a Box to your holiday host, your coworker, your neighbor

name: Candle of the Month Set
description: In the most literal sense, Trader Joe’s Candle of the Month Set is a collection of twelve thoughtfully scented Candles, made for us by the same celebrated supplier in Vietnam behind many of our other iconic, seasonal, scented candles. But it’s more than that, too. It’s like an advent calendar for Candles that lasts all year long. It’s like one of those “X of the month” subscription services, and all for a fraction of what those subscriptions typically cost. It’s also a fantastic gift option for anyone in your life who loves a nice, warm light and fun fragrance—even, and espeically, if that person happns to be yourself. Each Set contains a Candle for each month of the year, carefully curated to fit that month’s theme. There’s Sparkling Cuvee in January for celebrating the new year; romantic Raspberries & Cream for February; lucky Clover & Moss for March; rain-scented April Showers in April and fittingly floral May Flowers in May; beach- ready Sea Salt in June and Island Oasis in July; w

name: Spanish Sheep Milk Cheese with Quince Jam
description: From the land of rugged cliffs and golden fields that produce savory olives, saffron, and towering windmills... we present Trader Joe’s Spanish Sheep Milk Cheese with Quince Jam. Developed by experts exclusively for Trader Joe’s, this Spanish Cheese is crafted with fresh Sheep Milk sourced from the Mountains of Toledo and enhanced with locally sourced Quince, to deliver a classic Spanish pairing. Quince Jam is injected into the curds, after the Cheese has ripened for two months. (For those unfamiliar, Quince is a member of the rose family with tart, bracing flavor that turns sweet when cooked.) Then the combination is vacuum-sealed and allowed to mature for an additional three months. The finished, firm Cheese boasts veins of bright-pink Jam and a smooth, creamy, and salty profile that finishes with a hint of tart-sweet fruit. It’s a delightful harmony of flavors that pairs well with lamb, duck, chicken, and yes, Turkey! For a full tapas experience, serve with a Spanish red wine, slice

name: Break Apart Reindeer
description: Your giftees deserves a lil’ extra glee this holiday season... and Trader Joe’s Break Apart Reindeer just happens to deliver sweet, seasonal joy in a small, whimsical package. At first glance, it appears to be a simple, but cute, milk chocolate Reindeer with a sweet, cheery face. Inside this milk chocolate Reindeer, however, lies a playful twist: a handful of red, nose-shaped gummy candies (which happen to be gelatin-free!) Made for us in the United Kingdom by the same clever confectioner behind our Trader Joe’s Break Apart Bunny. Our Reindeer isn’t just for admiring in a stocking or mantle (no waxy, flavorless stuff here, folks!)—it’s formed from some darn good milk chocolate, and made to be broken apart and truly savored. Whether you start with a nibble on the antlers, break off a piece of a hoof, or dive straight into the gummy candy-filled center, our Break Apart Reindeer offers a celebration of the holidays in every bite.

name: Lasagna Soup
description: Just as soon as autumn gets into full swing and we start to sense those cool winter breezes on the horizon, our thoughts turn to one thing and one thing only: comfort foods. (All right, fine, one category of things, we suppose). Creamy pastas, steamy casseroles, hearty soups—we simply can’t get enough of them when the weather starts to get a little chilly. And this year, we may have just concocted the comfort food of all comfort foods: Trader Joe’s Lasagna Soup with Turkey. Combining elements from some of our all-time favorite comfort food classics (Cheese! Pasta! Savory-seasoned Turkey!) all into one superlatively savory, rib-sticking Soup, this is a real game-changer for the Trader Joe’s refrigerated section. And it’s available from the late fall to the very end of winter—you know, comfort food season. name: Clotted Cream Fudge
description: Last year, we carried a collection of full-flavored English fudges as part of our holiday candy selection, and as so often happens with these sorts of supergroups, one Fudge ended up becoming the breakout star. So now, back in our stores for this year’s holiday season for a highly anticipated solo tour, may we re-introduce to you Trader Joe’s Clotted Cream Fudge! Once again, it’s made expressly for us by an expert supplier in England, who uses a classic recipe that includes salted butter, sugar, sweetened condensed milk and, of course, Clotted Cream, to create a Fudge that’s sweet, crumbly, and exquisitely buttery, which simply melts in your mouth the moment you take a bite. For those who’ve never tried Clotted Cream before: it’s a preparation of fresh cream, commonly associated with southwestern English cuisine, made by steaming or scalding milk, then allowing it to cool until it thickens into something like a dense, lightly nutty, English version of mascarpone. name: Dark Chocolate Covered Peppermint Cremes
description: Classic creamy candies with a textural twist, each Dark Chocolate Covered Peppermint Creme begins with a velvety Peppermint center that’s enrobed in smooth Dark Chocolate. Topping each piece is a smattering of crushed peppermint candy, bringing an extra hit of mint and a pleasantly unexpected crunch in each bite. They’re packaged in a festively designed box, making them instantly giftable for neighbors, teachers, postal workers, et. al., and their incredible price will ensure you keep your cool and keep your wallet full when checking off your gift list.

name: Reserve Meritage Paso Robles 2023 Red Wine
description: Our latest vintage of Meritage within the Trader Joe’s Reserve label, made for us by a renowned winery in Paso Robles, contains all six of the classique Bordeaux grapes: Cabernet, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Cab Franc, Carmenere, and Malbec. Together, this carefully curated and beautifully balanced blend expresses itself with boldness, inspired by the traditional Claret versions of Bordeaux reds. In this respect, it presents our customers with a different style than most other Paso Robles wines we’ve offered in recent years. Big and flavorful, with complex notes of boysenberry, plum, cacao, and café au lait, this TJ’s Reserve Meritage would be just as welcome at the Thanksgiving table as it would be alongside a plate of smash burgers and fries, or even just sipped solo while enjoying a brisk autumn evening. Elevated yet unpretentious, it’s the kind of wine that truly punches above its weight.

name: Holiday Scented Candle Trio
description: Close your eyes and picture a pristine, piney forest on a perfect winter morning. You’re nice and warm, all bundled up, while all around you, fresh snow covers the forest floor like a big, fluffy blanket. Wild berries glitter with tiny little speckles of ice, while the occasional pinecone pokes its way through the sea of undisturbed white. Such is the scene that’s evoked via the aromas found in Trader Joe’s Holiday Scented Candle Tin Trio, a collection of soy-wax blend Candles in three wonderfully wintry Scents: Noble Fir, Foraged Cassis, and Cinnamon Pinecone. Like our other seasonal Scented Candle Tin Trios before it, each Candle within this aromatic assemblage provides a warm glow and unforgettable atmosphere. Noble Fir brings to mind a winter’s stroll along a wooded trail, Foraged Cassis evokes the aroma of freshly picked blackcurrants, and Cinnamon Pinecone captures the essence of a homemade potpourri at the holiday table. name: Sleigh Ride Cookies
description: The holidays are a time for many things: gathering with friends and family, reflecting on the year that’s past, planning for the year to come…and, of course, it’s also a time for cookies. Lots and lots of cookies. And though we have a section dedicated to them year round, our buyers especially delight in dreaming up holiday cookies for our customers. For this year’s holiday season, we’re introducing a true triumph in the field of cookiedom: Trader Joe’s Sleigh Ride Cookies. Starting with a sweet and buttery sugar cookie dough base, our supplier mixes in some crushed candy cane pieces and broken up Candy Cane Joe-Joe’s to provide a pleasant peppermint pop. Biting into this Cookie is a wonderfully wintry experience, full of soft, creamy, and crunchy textures and satisfyingly sweet and minty flavors. name: Maple Brioche Style Liège Waffles
description: Ever since we introduced Trader Joe’s Brioche Style Liège Waffles in 2024, our customers have reveled in this snacky excuse to enjoy waffles outside of breakfast. Funnily enough, our latest take on the Liège Waffle experience relies on a flavor profile that’s especially celebrated during the morning meal. In any case, for a limited time, please welcome Trader Joe’s Maple Brioche Style Liège Waffles! Our Belgian supplier follows authentic Liège tradition by adding egg to the batter, which produces a dense, brioche-like flavor. Gilding the lily, Maple syrup is added for rich warmth and sweetness in every bite. Winsome for their smaller (than breakfast-style waffles) size, their roundish shape, and their uneven edges, the charm of these imperfections is further enhanced by a sprinkling of coarse pearl sugar (which also provides an unexpected and delicate crunch). name: Everything but the Bartender Gin & Tonic
description: Whether you’re hosting a Friendsgiving Fête or Thanksgiving Day buffet, or simply looking to relax with a post-work beverage on a random Wednesday, Trader Joe’s Everything But The Bartender Gin & Tonic is here to answer the call. This bubbly and refreshing, ready-to-drink Gin & Tonic combines herbal gin, bright lime juice, water, sugar, natural flavors, and carbonation. It’s further embellished by butterfly pea flower to achieve a striking purplish hue for an utterly satisfying cocktail bar experience in your glass—all without the Bartender, of course. Enjoy over ice, with a lime wedge or lemon wheel, or simply sip chilled, straight from the can, as you put the finishing touches on the T-day fixins’. Thanksgiving menu aside, this G&T is a swell companion to smoked fish, fresh berries, and strong, savory cheeses (Totally Cheeseball Unexpected Cheddar Spread, anyone?)
ingredients: WATER GIN LIME JUICE FROM CONCENTRATE CANE SUGAR NATURAL FLAVORS VEGETABLE JUICE COLOR (BUTTERFLY PEA FLOWER EXTRACT)

name: Cranberry Pecan Muffins
description: Nothing quite says “Good morning!” like a muffin. We’re, of course, speaking figuratively here; if you come across a muffin that actually talks, that’s out of our wheelhouse. But the point stands: there’s just something about waking up to a satisfying muffin on your plate that makes a morning feel special, and makes you feel ready to take on the day. That’s precisely the feeling we intend to evoke with Trader Joe’s Cranberry Pecan Muffins. This four-pack of maple-y Muffins plays to every one of the genre’s strengths: a crumbly, cakey texture (thanks, sour cream!), zippy hints of orange zest, and, of course, plenty of bright fresh Cranberries and toothsome Pecans in each bite. The finishing touch of streusel topping makes them extra special, indeed. While they’re perfectly delicious when enjoyed as a quick, on- the-go breakfast snack or brunch side, we contend that they truly excel when heated up a bit in the toaster oven or microwave — the maple syrup aromatics alone are well worth the
ingredients: ENRICHED WHEAT FLOUR (WHEAT FLOUR, NIACIN, THIAMINE MONONITRATE, REDUCED IRON, RIBOFLAVIN, FOLIC ACID), BROWN SUGAR, CANOLA OIL, CRANBERRIES, EGGS, CANE SUGAR, WATER, SOUR CREAM (CULTURED CREAM, MICROBIAL ENZYME), PECANS, EGG YOLK, MAPLE SYRUP, NATURAL FLAVOR, MODIFIED CORNSTARCH, LEAVENING (BAKING SODA, CALCIUM ACID PYROPHOSPHATE, MONOCALCIUM PHOSPHATE), ORANGE PEEL (ORANGE PEEL, WATER, CITRIC ACID [ACIDIFIER]), SALT.

name: Trader Jaques' La Fondue
description: Trader Jacques' La Fondue comes to us from the French Alps, where Gruyere, Emmental and Comté cheeses are crafted from the milk of cows grazed on lush alpine grasses. When heated through, this Fondue becomes beautifully bubbly, alluringly aromatic with notes of crisp white wine, and ideal for all sorts of dipping. Best of all, you can prep it in the microwave in five minutes, and if convenience is paramount, you can even serve it in its own package! We recommend enjoying it with anything from bread cubes and cornichons, to Ham and salami, to veggies and fruit… since you don’t have to spend time and energy preparing the fondue itself, you can focus all your energies on what you’re going to dunk! Oh, the possibilities…
